current_fee_break_even.current_fee_formula_per_leg: shares * feeSchedule.rate * price * (1 - price) for exponent 1; use each market's exact current feeSchedule rather than assuming the category reference
current_fee_break_even.maker_path_policy: do_not_credit_zero_maker_fee_or_rebate_without_owned_queue_causal_both_leg_fills_and_full_orphan_inventory_unwind_cost; the primary recurrence screen is all_taker

distinctness_from_terminal_families.reason: the prior threshold_deadline screen froze a different exact-rule population and found zero gross-positive pairs; the 2026 NBA primary study reports recurrent event-time violations across isolated live full-game moneyline and spread books with a deterministic same-game payoff implication
distinctness_from_terminal_families.single_market_result: the paper's seven single-market episodes remain within the already-terminal complete-set family and do_not_reopen_it

historical_primary_evidence.warning: the paper explicitly used zero NBA trading fees and therefore does not establish current after-fee profitability

limitations: No current NBA market catalog order book fee schedule episode fill or after-cost result was sampled in this adjudication.
The primary paper covers one month and one sport and reports top-of-book availability rather than owned simultaneous fills.
The paper forward-filled asynchronous books and polled each market every 3.6 to 5.5 seconds, so reported durations are upper bounds and some detected states may be stale for a faster executor.
The paper's zero-fee assumption conflicts with the current official category schedule, which lists a 0.05 sports taker rate; exact market fee schedules can differ and must be read per market.
A spread with an integer handicap can introduce a push or equality state; the guaranteed one-dollar floor is unproved unless the exact paired resolution rules cover that state.
The possible two-dollar middle had zero realizations in the historical sample and receives zero value in the acceptance gate.
Retail-scale historical depth does not establish recurring capacity after current fees latency cancellations partial fills and external costs.

payoff_identity.required_push_tie_overtime_gate: exact market rules must prove overtime inclusion and settlement for push equality cancellation postponement forfeit and correction states; any uncovered state rejects the pair

prospective_recurrence_contract.economic_gate: for one identical feasible share quantity at displayed top-of-book depth net guaranteed payout after both exact taker fees fee rounding every external cost and a preregistered operational_orphan stress must be strictly positive
prospective_recurrence_contract.episode_policy: deduplicate consecutive source states and count at most one executable quantity per episode; never sum repeated snapshots as replenished liquidity
prospective_recurrence_contract.execution_causality_gate: both legs must coexist in the same retained batch response and remain within a source-age and inter-book timestamp ceiling frozen from a separate no-outcome preflight before the first recurrence observation; stale forward-fill is not accepted
prospective_recurrence_contract.fee_gate: use each exact market fee schedule at observation time; a missing contradictory or changed fee field rejects the state
prospective_recurrence_contract.minimum_evidence_for_promotion: recurrent positive all-taker episodes across multiple independent games including pre-game and in-game phase reporting with no reliance on the middle payout and with positive aggregate and worst-game after-cost economics
prospective_recurrence_contract.resolution_gate: machine-checked exhaustive final-score payoff table from the exact paired market rules before any book is admitted
stop_conditions: integer or other handicap equality state without source-proved non-loss settlement
post-game physical conclusion halted stale closed or non-accepting market
either best ask or sufficient displayed size missing
combined asks plus exact taker fees plus frozen costs not strictly below guaranteed payout
source timestamps violate the frozen synchronization ceiling

prohibited_shortcuts: reusing the paper's zero-fee median as current profit
assuming all spreads are complements or that integer-handicap pushes pay one dollar across the pair
forward-filling a stale leg until an apparent arbitrage appears
using midpoint last trade uncapped depth or post-game quotes as executable asks
crediting maker economics without causal owned both-leg fills and orphan unwind
calling a read-only recurrence profitable or deployment-ready without owned fill reconciliation and all external costs
placing either leg or accepting legging risk without separate explicit trading authority
